summary: Feed s147_double to NDR is degraded: VLAN 20 completely missing (49% untagged) and 7.0% TCP packet loss detected. Both faults blind NDR detection for VLAN 20 and break stream reassembly.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or aggregation TAP is stripping 802.1Q tags or VLAN 20 is filtered/not trunked to the broker. Required VLAN 20 not seen at all and 49% of packets are untagged, indicating tag preservation is disabled or an allow-list is dropping VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires VLANs 10,20 for tenant/segment attribution. Without VLAN 20 tags it cannot isolate or correlate traffic for that segment, creating a complete visibility blind spot and breaking VLAN-aware detection policies.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end and ensure trunk/broker filter forwards both required VLANs so NDR receives correct segmentation.

findings.root_cause: Upstream drops before the NDR - most likely SPAN oversubscription/buffer exhaustion or packet-broker ingress drops. 171 of 2435 TCP packets (7.0%) show gaps/retransmissions exceeding 1% threshold, while tool_overload is healthy, pointing to SPAN/broker loss not tool NIC overload.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs both directions and full payload for stream reassembly. 7% missing data causes incomplete flows, failed reassembly, missed signatures and increased false negatives - attacker traffic can evade detection.

recommended_fix.why: Replace lossy SPAN with passive TAP and properly buffered broker aggregation to eliminate oversubscription drops and deliver lossless traffic within NDR 10Gbps/9216B limits.
